The '''Dubrava system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Dubravan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
